# Monitor Qwen s123 (PID 4271) and s456 (PID 4561) training
# When each finishes, auto-launch eval on the designated GPU
# s123 → GPU 0, s456 → GPU 3

        if ! ps -p $S123_PID > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "[$(date)] s123 training (PID $S123_PID) finished!"
